messages:
elaine: Quick recap from today's pilot kickoff with Verdant Health — they want a 4-week POC to validate QA and summarization on clinical notes. Key ask: customer-provided sample (≈200k records), strict PHI redaction, and connectivity via either VPC peering or presigned S3.

devon: Got it. For the sample, do they want client-side redaction before upload or do we run our scrubber in the sandbox?

olivia: We prefer to scrub on our side first but can also send a masked sample. Compliance wants to see the redaction rules we use.

sam: @olivia we'll need the security questionnaire answered before we accept any real PHI into the sandbox. Also need DPA + SOC2/ISO attachments.

elaine: Action items: Verdant to provide a masked sample by Fri (3/27). If they can't, we provide a scripted scrubber they can run.

devon: Proposal for scrubber: small client-side script that replaces names, MRNs, SSNs with tokens, and hashes patient IDs. Example: `python scrubber.py --mask --fields name,ssn,mrn --salt <seed>`

olivia: That script works. Can you share an example output schema?

devon: Example JSON line: `{"note_id":"<hash>","text":"Patient reported cough, DOB:[REDACTED]","meta":{"visit_date":"2024-11-02"}}`

sam: Security note: If they insist on full PHI in our environment we require VPC Private + customer-managed KMS and annual pen test evidence. Otherwise hosted sandbox is only for de-identified data.

elaine: Pricing question from Verdant: what are the two pilot options?

devon: Option A — Hosted pilot (no infra changes): small hosted quota, pay-as-you-go. Good for quick evals but only for de-identified data. Estimated pilot usage: ~100k tokens/day => ~$600/week.

devon: Option B — Dedicated pilot (reserved capacity on a small GPU pool, VPC): supports PHI, SLA, predictable throughput. Rough estimate: $6k/month reserved + usage.

elaine: I'll share both numbers and call out security constraints.

olivia: Timeline question — is 4 weeks realistic?

devon: Yes if we get sample and network creds in week 1. Week 2 build index + prompts, week 3 run evals & iterate, week 4 polish UX and handoff.

sam: Success criteria we want captured: 1) Redaction recall >=95% on provided test set; 2) QA latency P50 <300ms, P95 <800ms for single-shot queries; 3) Retrieval/QA accuracy >= 85% on vetted prompts; 4) No PHI stored in hosted sandbox (if hosted route).

elaine: I'll send a short SOW + success criteria doc to Verdant today.

devon: For connectivity — prefer VPC peering + route table. If they can't do peering, we can accept presigned S3 uploads via the following flow: 1) AE requests presigned URL, 2) customer uploads to `s3://redwood-pilot-uploads/<customer>/`, 3) infra-bot triggers ingestion. Example presign command: `aws s3 presign s3://redwood-pilot-uploads/verdant/sample.ndjson --expires-in 3600`

infra-bot: Reminder: requesting presigned bucket requires customer org ID + support ticket. File retention defaults to 30 days for pilots.

olivia: We'll check with infra for peering — should know by EOD Thu. If peering blocked, we'll do presigned.

elaine: Who owns the eval plan? Need prompts, test queries, and grading rubric.

devon: I'll draft a prompt set (50 queries) and an eval harness that runs N=3 temperature sweeps, cosine similarity threshold for retrieval at 0.78. Will post in #eng-ml.

sam: Also attach the security questionnaire answers and the redaction test cases to the SOW.

elaine: Perfect. Next sync Thu 10am PT with Verdant, bring network + legal. :thumbsup:
